title: Full payment-card data (PAN, CVV) logged destructured by the ordering mediator pipeline
owner_hint: no CODEOWNERS entry; top committer: Aditya Mandaleeka; component: Ordering.API/
rationale: Overrides CreateOrderCommand.ToString() to emit a fixed non-card summary (CreateOrderCommand(UserId: ...)), making every {@Command} sink (LoggingBehavior, TransactionBehavior:41/:59, ValidatorBehavior, IdentifiedCommandHandler, OrdersApi wrapper) safe regardless of formatter semantics — the structural fix for the hazard the code itself flags at OrdersApi.cs:126-130. f009's raw-record sink is intentionally not touched here.
variants_checked: All other commands carry only OrderNumber/items — CreateOrderCommand is the only payment-data carrier; CreateOrderDraftCommand safe.
bypass_considered: ToString-based renderers now get the redacted summary; residual: reflection-serializing formatters (e.g. JSON console) would bypass ToString — noted, out of minimal scope; f009 covers the raw-request sink.
test_note: Create_Order_Command_ToString_Check_No_Card_Data in tests/Ordering.UnitTests/Application/CreateOrderCommandTest.cs asserts no card field appears in ToString output.
review_reason: Root-cause fix at the leak's source (the object's own rendering), covering all 15 {@Command} sites in one move; purely additive override with a convention-matching test.
